displayDescription: A lightbulb is shaded in three wax passes, then one page turn on the gutter reveals the connected wax network.
motionEngine: GSAP (local gsap.min.js, one paused timeline at window.__timelines.video)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, sound effects, narration or subtitles.
limitations: The crayon wax is simulated: seeded, bristled Canvas 2D hatching clipped to jittered masks, with a cached procedural paper-tooth texture erasing it. No scanned crayon or real paper is used.

The page turn is a 2D projection drawn in strips (foreshortening, a slight lift of the outer edge, gradient shading and a cast shadow) bound to a fixed gutter. It is not a 3D or physically simulated paper bend, and the leaf doesn't curl.
The finished bulb on the turned leaf's verso is drawn as a clean copy in the mirrored position, not as real wax bleeding through the paper.
Blender was not used, as instructed. GSAP is loaded from the project-local gsap.min.js; no packages were installed.
The project dependency record could not be written: the selection tool failed because PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json is missing from this preview folder.
Lettering uses local system fonts (Chalkboard SE, with Comic Sans MS, Marker Felt and sans-serif as fallbacks).
